sobre.title: ABOUT ME
sobre.subtitle: SOFTWARE ENGINEERING & NOTARIAL PRECISION
sobre.quote: “Notarial precision demands public trust and absolute rigor. I bring that same legal discipline into software architecture: clean, auditable code with zero tolerance for failure.”
sobre.bioP1: I am a Full Stack Software Engineer with solid expertise in modern web development (React, Next.js 15, TypeScript, Node.js, Python), intelligent workflow automation, and Generative AI agents (RAG / Tool Calling).
sobre.bioP2: I possess hands-on technical and legal background in Public Notary & Deed Registry offices, shaping my vision to build systems with maximum data integrity, high availability, corporate cybersecurity, and strict compliance.
sobre.card1Desc: Architecture designed to eliminate critical bugs and failures in production environments.
sobre.card2Desc: Custom RAG pipelines, deed drafting automation, and autonomous assistance.
sobre.card3Desc: GPU-accelerated WebGL rendering and zero jank across all mobile and desktop devices.
